english.title: Unauthorised cleaning of aircraft/vehicles/equipment - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) cleaned, serviced or maintained

(A)_[an aircraft]_
(B)_[a vehicle]_
(C)_[equipment]_

namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT VEHICLE OR EQUIPMENT..), in an area of Liverpool John Lennon Airport, where such activity was prohibited by notice issued by Liverpool Airport Limited without first obtaining the permission of Liverpool Airport Limited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(b) and 4(2) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
